result.summary: Found 1 significant navigation-state issue; the rest of the visible layout appears consistent.

issues.description: The page shows the restaurant discovery/home feed, but the bottom navigation highlights “Profile” in green while “Home” remains inactive. This gives users an incorrect indication of their current section.
issues.suggestion: Set “Home” as the active bottom-navigation item on this screen and reserve the active “Profile” state for the profile page.
